title: Sweet Fettuccine with Fried Glaze
description: A gluten-free dessert made with fettuccine, a sweet fried glaze, and a touch of fun.
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a saucepan, combine sugar and 1/4 cup water. Heat over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Increase heat to medium-high and bring to a boil. Cook for 5 minutes or until the mixture turns a deep amber color.
Remove from heat and carefully pour in vegetable oil. The mixture will bubble up and steam vigorously, so be careful.
Return the saucepan to medium heat and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the glaze has thickened slightly.
Add cooked fettuccine to the saucepan and toss to coat with the sweet fried glaze.
Note: This recipe is a fun twist on traditional desserts. The fried glaze adds a unique texture and flavor.
Optional: Top with sprinkles, whipped cream, or chopped nuts for added fun.
